description: This file appears to be a C header file defining version and system information for a software project. It declares external version strings, functions to retrieve user agent information, and a function to get system information using 'uname'.

methods.name: git_user_agent
methods.description: Returns a string representing the user agent for the git process.

methods.name: git_user_agent_sanitized
methods.description: Returns a sanitized version of the user agent string.

methods.name: get_uname_info
methods.description: Retrieves system information using uname(2) and fills the provided buffer. Returns -1 on error and 0 on success.
